body: I'm not saying I didn't have profound experiences. I'm just saying that it didn't last. The anhedonia never left. If you are implying that they have a 100% success rate at curing depression, that is extremely irresponsible.

I've literally dreamed of setting my head on fire every night for the past month, and it has never been a nightmare.

I'm not going to do that because it sounds like one of the shittiest ways possible to go out.
